notes: flux_linkage_peak tolerance is wide (30%) by design: the Zhu & Howe fundamental model underestimates flux linkage for 22p/24s FSCW machines because this topology couples via sub-harmonics not captured by k_w × B_1. Expected field-predicted deviation ~24%.

B_ag_peak.semantic_note: Published 0.776 T is from Eq. 2: B_PM = B_r·h_m/(g + h_m/α_p), a simplified flat-top formula assuming infinite μ_r. FEM peak includes slot harmonics and will exceed this value.

backemf_peak.semantic_note: Waveform peak ≈ fundamental for nearly-sinusoidal machine. Valid within stated tolerance.
